text:
Jun Park: Quick spike proposal — run a small, reproducible sampling job to capture per-head statistics (logit variance, entropy, SNR) for FP8 + INT4 fallback combos. Output should power a simple degradation classifier.
Priya Singh: Sounds good. What dataset and prompts are we using?
Jun Park: Start with: 3k conversations from convo-suite (mix of long/short), 1k instruction-style prompts, 500 edge-case hallucination probes. Keep seed for repeatability.
Lina Gomez: Telemetry names we should standardize: `quant.head_variance`, `quant.head_snr`, `quant.layer_entropy`, `quant.tail_error_rate`.
Ben O'Rourke: Will need a small canary path. Can we shadow these samples in prod for a few hours before deciding thresholds? :thinking_face: 
Sam Wu: ops note — shadowing at token-level will spike egress/storage. Estimate: ~200GB/day for 10k requests. Need approval or sampling down to 10%.
Marco Bell: Add calibration anchors: keep a golden model run (fp32 baseline) and store per-sample delta stats so we can compute degradation distribution.
Jun Park: Agreed. Plan: run offline 100% for the probe dataset, then 10% shadow in staging, then canary in prod if metrics stable.
Priya Singh: What classifier do we want? Simple logistic on per-head SNR + layer mean diff? Or something nonparametric?
Lina Gomez: Start simple: logistic + calibrated thresholds. If that's noisy, switch to small tree ensemble. Keep features lightweight.
Ben O'Rourke: Operational checklist items:
- tag runs with `quant_probe:<fp_version>:<int_version>`
- persist only aggregated metrics for 90 days
- raw diffs kept for 7 days for bisecting
ops-bot: Resource quota check: inference-cluster low-prio queue available between 02:00-06:00 UTC, estimated run time 3h.
Sam Wu: Noted. Schedule in that window to avoid interfering with regular canaries.
Jun Park: Minimal CLI to kick off probe:
```
# run probe (example)
python tools/quant_probe.py --dataset convo-suite --samples 4500 --modes fp8,int4 --out /tmp/quant_probe/run_1834567890 --seed 42
```
Priya Singh: Good. Who owns the PR to wire metrics -> grafana + alerts?
Lina Gomez: I'll do dashboards. Alerting rules: fire if P95 head_snr drop > 0.25 relative to fp32 baseline AND tail_error_rate > 1%.
Marco Bell: Also add a regression playbook note: if alert fires, rollback policy is "auto-fallback to fp32-compatible variant"; ops to triage within 30m.
Ben O'Rourke: Can we surface per-customer slices too? Some tenants are more sensitive.
Jun Park: Yes, add tag `customer_slice` to aggregated outputs. We'll keep default off for privacy but enable for enterprise customers on request.
Priya Singh: Timeline?
Jun Park: Spike + offline run this week (ETA Fri). Staging shadow next week. Canary the week after if no red flags.
Lina Gomez: I'll create the dashboard skeleton and share link.
Sam Wu: I'll book the low-prio window and confirm storage quota.
Marco Bell: I'll add calibration anchor scripts to the repo.
Jun Park: Thanks all — will open PRs for the probe script + doc. Please add quick comments on the runbook draft when I post it.
